serverUrl.name: Jitsi server address
serverUrl.hint: Your Jitsi Meet server, such as https://meet.example.com (its XMPP WebSocket is found at /xmpp-websocket). Plain http:// works only on this computer or a private network. The server needs token authentication and Prosody's presence_identity module; see the module's README. Every player can read this setting.

xmppDomain.name: XMPP domain
xmppDomain.hint: Leave empty when it is the server's host name. Docker installs of Jitsi use meet.jitsi.

mucDomain.name: Conference domain
mucDomain.hint: Leave empty for conference.<XMPP domain>. Docker installs of Jitsi use muc.meet.jitsi.

appId.name: Jitsi app id
appId.hint: The server's JWT_APP_ID. Stored only in this browser. Players get short-lived tokens from a GM's browser.

appSecret.name: Jitsi app secret
appSecret.hint: The server's JWT_APP_SECRET. Stored only in this browser and never sent to players. Enter it on each browser a GM uses to run the game.
